title: How long is one sleep cycle?

probes.question: How many times does the NREM and REM cycle occur in a good night's sleep?
True or false: a sleep cycle alternates between NREM and REM sleep.

image.alt: Flat illustration of a person asleep in a bed beneath a night window showing a crescent moon and stars.

body.question: On average, how long does one cycle of alternating NREM and REM sleep take?
body.reveal: The sleep cycle of alternate NREM and REM sleep takes an average of 90 minutes, occurring 4–6 times in a good night's sleep.
